title: Derived researcher-at-IIS predicate
objective: Create a derived predicate that returns each person connected through one participation resource to organization urn:logiclens:org:iis with the Russian role literal исследователь. The second argument must be the sorted FactId evidence used for participant, organization and role conditions.
acceptance: Use only the provider-neutral epoch candidate v0 files declared by the task.
Return a person only when one participation resource supplies participant, in-org and role evidence.
Require organization urn:logiclens:org:iis and literal исследователь with language ru.
Return the three supporting FactId values sorted with ordinal Prolog term order.
Bind urn:logiclens:derived:researcher-at-iis to the trusted Property component.
Do not modify or activate the active epoch.
